steps.en: Point it at a GGUF file and start the server
steps.zh: 指向一个 GGUF 文件并启动服务

steps.en: Loads the model onto your GPU via WebGPU and serves OpenAI-compatible endpoints
steps.zh: 通过 WebGPU 把模型加载到显卡，对外提供 OpenAI 兼容接口

steps.en: Call it from any OpenAI SDK or curl
steps.zh: 用任意 OpenAI SDK 或 curl 调用

value.en: Your existing OpenAI-SDK tools talk to a local model — no Python, no Docker, no account
value.zh: 你现有的 OpenAI SDK 工具直接连上本地模型——不要 Python、不要 Docker、不要账号

sources: shimmy README.md Quick Start: `cargo install shimmy`; `shimmy serve --model-path /absolute/path/to/model.gguf --bind 127.0.0.1:11435`; `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/chat/completions`
